mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chem_check(code, scope_category, checker_one_id, checker_two_id, diff_count, result) VALUES(#{code}, #{scopeCategory}, #{checkerOneId}, #{checkerTwoId}, #{diffCount}, #{result})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chem_check WHERE code LIKE CONCAT(#{dayPrefix}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE chem_check SET diff_count = #{diffCount}, result = #{result}, checked_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND result = 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u1.nickname AS checker_one_name, u2.nickname AS checker_two_name FROM chem_check c LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON c.checker_one_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON c.checker_two_id = u2.id WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.result = #{result} ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chem_check c WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.result = #{result}
